name: print-social-mossy-driftwood-still-life-with-flat-green-and-giant-caps
title: Sage-green post with giant white question, small body copy and a mossy driftwood still life
whatItIs: A flat sage-green portrait with a huge white geometric caps question over two lines, a small paragraph with an asterisk bullet, a wordmark, and a cutout of a mossy driftwood piece with lichens and flowers rising diagonally at the lower right.
whatItMeans: Contemplative and organic; the tree is a metaphor for hidden desires.
techniques: Set a huge question as the headline.
Use a single object cutout as the image.

vocabulary.definition: An object standing in for an idea.
A cutout placed at an angle.
A headline phrased as a question.
